# Quick pickles

Cucumbers sliced thin, packed in a jar with a brine of one part rice vinegar, one part water, a tablespoon of sugar
and two teaspoons of salt. They are ready after one hour in the fridge and last about a week.

## Lacto fermented version

For real fermentation skip the vinegar: a 3 percent salt brine at room temperature for four days, burped every day.
The same jar method works for the fermented garlic honey. Like the [[Sourdough]] starter it wants a warm kitchen.
